title: Alien in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- alien body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='24' fill='#5BE36B'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='67' rx='13' ry='16' fill='#9CF5A6'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#6BEE7A'/>
  <!-- big alien eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='32' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#1E2A44'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='32' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#1E2A44'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='29' r='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='29' r='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- antenna stalks -->
  <line x1='43' y1='20' x2='39' y2='8' stroke='#6BEE7A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='57' y1='20' x2='61' y2='8' stroke='#6BEE7A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antenna bulbs -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='7' r='4' fill='#FF6FA8'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='7' r='4' fill='#FFD23F'/>
  <!-- little scarf -->
  <path d='M30 46 Q50 54 70 46 L70 53 Q50 61 30 53 Z' fill='#E8453C'/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M62 52 L72 66 L62 68 Z' fill='#FF7A55'/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <rect x='44' y='47' width='6' height='9' fill='#FFD23F' transform='rotate(2 47 51)'/>
  <!-- tiny arms -->
  <line x1='29' y1='62' x2='19' y2='72' stroke='#5BE36B' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='71' y1='62' x2='81' y2='72' stroke='#5BE36B' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#3FBF4E'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#3FBF4E'/>
</svg>
